id.description: The unique identifier of the source

key.description: The key of the source file in the storage

path.description: The path of the source file

description.description: A brief description of the source

originalName.description: The original name of the file

indexStatus.description: The indexing status of the source

indexError.description: The error message if indexing fails

memoryId.description: The ID of the memory associated with this source

knowledgeId.description: The ID of the knowledge base this source belongs to

tenantId.description: The ID of the tenant this source belongs to

folderId.description: The ID of the folder this source belongs to

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the source was created

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the source was last updated
